details.plan: Spatial depth disparity indicates physical vertical drop of 35.0cm. Trigger high-priority auditory guidance; monitor IMU for stumble.

details.spoken_prompt: Caution: Abrupt step down of approximately 35cm detected ahead.

steps.action: Autonomous SOS Escalation to Caregiver & Clinic

details.tool_input: AUTOMATED EMERGENCY: Patient stumbled near detected 3D step-down (35.0cm drop) (OpenCV salience score: 0.0083). Immediate check required.

tool_output.message: SOS alert dispatched: AUTOMATED EMERGENCY: Patient stumbled near detected 3D step-down (35.0cm drop) (OpenCV salience score: 0.0083). Immediate check required.
tool_output.next_steps: Your caregiver has been notified and can see your location. Stay where you are if it's safe. I'll keep monitoring your surroundings and guide you.

payload.final_action_taken: Emergency SOS Alert Dispatched to Clinic and Caregiver

steps.action: Active Guardrail Trigger: Medication Conflict Detected

details.action: HALT administration immediately; require doctor review.

steps.action: Escalate Discrepancy Note to Attending Optometrist EHR Chart
